```yaml
name: Draft Release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      new_version:
        description: 'New version to release (e.g., 1.0.0). If not provided, auto-determined.'
        required: false
        type: string
      model:
        description: 'Model abbreviation (e.g., codex, glm, kimi) or full name for changelog generation.'
        required: false
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  draft-release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check actor permissions
        if: ${{ github.actor != 'dyoshikawa' && github.actor != 'cm-dyoshikawa' }}
        run: |
          echo "Error: Only dyoshikawa or cm-dyoshikawa can trigger this workflow."
          exit 1

      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Resolve Model Input
        id: resolve-model
        if: ${{ inputs.model }}
        uses: dyoshikawa/rulesync/.github/actions/select-opencode-model@main
        with:
          input-text: ${{ inputs.model }}

      - name: Determine Version
        id: version
        run: |
          if [ -n "${{ inputs.new_version }}" ]; then
            VERSION="${{ inputs.new_version }}"
          else
            # Auto-determine version using release-dry-run logic
            # Assuming a script or command exists to determine next version
            # For TypeScript/Node projects, often using standard-version or similar
            # Here we simulate the logic described: "release-dry-run logic"
            # If using standard-version:
            # npx standard-version --dry-run --no-verify --no-verify-access --no-changelog --no-tag
            # But since we need the value, let's assume a script or npm script exists.
            # If not, we fallback to a simple bump or require manual input.
            # Given the prompt implies "auto-determines", we assume a tool is available.
            # Let's assume `npm run version:dry-run` outputs the version.
            VERSION=$(npm run version:dry-run 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' | head -n 1)
            
            if [ -z "$VERSION" ]; then
              echo "Error: Could not auto-determine version. Please provide new_version input."
              exit 1
            fi
          fi
          echo "version=$VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "Resolved version: $VERSION"

      - name: Generate Changelog
        id: changelog
        run: |
          VERSION="${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}"
          MODEL_INPUT="${{ steps.resolve-model.outputs.cleaned-text || inputs.model }}"
          
          # Placeholder for actual changelog generation logic
          # This might involve calling an AI model if MODEL_INPUT is provided
          # or using standard-version changelog generation
          
          if [ -n "$MODEL_INPUT" ]; then
            # If model is specified, potentially use it to generate a custom changelog
            # This is a placeholder for the actual AI integration step
            echo "Using model: $MODEL_INPUT for changelog generation"
            # Example: npx opencode --model $MODEL_INPUT --prompt "Generate changelog for $VERSION"
            CHANGELOG_BODY="Changelog generated using $MODEL_INPUT for version $VERSION"
          else
            # Standard changelog generation
            CHANGELOG_BODY="Standard changelog for version $VERSION"
          fi
          
          echo "body<<EOF" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "$CHANGELOG_BODY" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "EOF" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Create Release Branch and PR
        id: create-pr
        run: |
          VERSION="${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}"
          BRANCH_NAME="release/$VERSION"
          
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          
          git checkout -b $BRANCH_NAME
          
          # Update version in package.json if not already done by versioning tool
          # npm version $VERSION --no-git-tag-version
          
          git add .
          git commit -m "chore: release $VERSION"
          git push origin $BRANCH_NAME
          
          # Create Pull Request
          gh pr create \
            --title "Release $VERSION" \
            --body "Automated release PR for version $VERSION" \
            --base main \
            --head $BRANCH_NAME

      - name: Create Draft GitHub Release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
          name: Release ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
          body: ${{ steps.changelog.outputs.body }}
          draft: true
          target_commitish: main
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Trigger Publish Assets Workflow
        uses: benc-uk/workflow-dispatch@v1
        with:
          workflow: publish-assets.yml
          inputs: '{"version": "${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}"}'
          wait-for-completion: true
          wait-timeout-seconds: 300
```
